stem.text: Two wires, one made of brass and the other of steel, are stretched in an experiment. Both wires obey Hooke’s law during this experiment.
The Young modulus for brass is less than the Young modulus for steel.
Which graph shows how the stress varies with strain for both wires in this experiment?

A.alt: Graph of stress against strain with two curves labelled steel and brass, both starting at 0.

B.alt: Graph of stress against strain with two lines labelled steel and brass, both starting at 0.

C.alt: Graph of stress against strain with two curves labelled brass and steel, both starting at 0.

D.alt: Graph of stress against strain with two lines labelled brass and steel, both starting at 0.
